judge.summary: The repository contains a complete, runnable implementation of a simplified Monopoly Go! game. All core mechanics—dice rolling, board navigation, property purchase, rent payment, chance cards, money tracking, jail handling, free parking, and end‑game logic—are present and integrated. The code is syntactically correct, uses only standard library modules, and includes interactive console prompts. Minor polish (e.g., richer UI, property mortgage) is absent but does not affect core functionality, so the submission meets the benchmark requirements.
